All 65 article-wrapping cards behave this way, and the live page still uses this markup. Chromium does not let an article descendant contribute to name-from-content, so the link has no programmatic name. Browse-mode screen readers may still read the inner text, but voice control, focus announcements that rely on the name, and link lists get nothing. This is a real 4.1.2 (and 2.4.4) problem. The fix is aria-labelledby on the h3, or the article placed outside the link.
